questions.question: Descibe the calculation of claims to be debited to revenue account. / [CO1]

  • outstanding claim is added and opening outstanding claim is deducted from claim.2) Claim
  • on reinsurance ceded is deducted and claim on reinsurance accepted is added in Schedule 4

questions.question: What are the qualitative indicators used for measuring a banks performance? / [CO4] [7x4 = 28]
questions.solution_html:
• Qualitative Indicators for evaluating bank performance are:1) Customer Service quality -
  • how effectively a bank meets the expectations of its customers through products,
  • communications and overall service experience.2) Technology Adoption: Adoption of
  • technology improves efficiency, security, customer experience and competitiveness. Digital
  • banking, automation, data driven decisions etc are examples. It increases transparency
  • reduces fraud, becomes cost effective.3) Management efficiency: Quality of managemen t in
  • utilising its resources, sustained profitability, financial stability and customer trust are
  • examples of the efficiency of management.4) Compliance and Risk Management: In order to
  • maintain stability, ensure sustainability and reduce loss banks have t o follow RBI Guidelines,
  • Banking Regulation Act, FEMA, KYC , AML norms etc. Adherence to Laws such as Companies
  • Act, Income Tax Act, PMLA etc and follow Code of Conduct, Operational Manuals and audit
  • recommendations. (Points like Corporate Governance, Employee engagement, Cyber security
  • and any other relevant factor- ) Any 3 points with brief explanation-

(ii) Unsecured creditors are to receive 50 paise in the rupee in full settlement of their claims at par value in 7% Debentures of M/s Fortune Limited. (iii) 2,500 Equity Shares of Rs. 100 each, Rs. 60 paid, are to be distributed pro rata to existing shareholders.
